items.text: I was honored to receive the Family Award from @FaithandFreedom this week. On #ReligiousFreedomDay, we celebrate the right Americans have to freely exercise their faith and we commit to always defending that right. https://t.co/wO9J4JGVmu

Many North Dakotans have a friend or loved one who has been diagnosed with cancer or they themselves have battled the disease. On #WorldCancerDay, we commit to raising awareness of cancer prevention, detection, and treatment. https://t.co/cz4HX73IOG

The sweeping vaccine mandate on America’s healthcare professionals is overreaching and does nothing to improve the quality of care in our communities, especially in rural areas like North Dakota.
https://t.co/JAjUse7Vhu

.@SanfordHealth provides care to communities large and small across North Dakota. I met their new President and CEO Bill Gassen today and I am excited to work with him and his team as we look for ways to expand healthcare access in our state. https://t.co/Gby8smJttP

It was great to visit with the North Dakota School Nutrition Association about the importance of providing nutritional meals for students and ways we can bring more local food products into our schools. https://t.co/IKSd2imKkI

Checkable Medical in West Fargo is developing technologies aimed at making it easier for families to access healthcare services from the comfort of their homes. It is great to have a North Dakota company leading the way in telehealth. https://t.co/YJ3wqOAkL7

I welcomed the Independent Insurance Agents of North Dakota to DC recently for the Big “I” Independent Insurance Agents Conference. Thank you to them for stopping by to discuss crop insurance for our farmers and ranchers and the importance of supporting small businesses. https://t.co/JzngPcgiFE
Leaders with the North Dakota Chiropractic Association stopped by my office this week to talk about efforts to expand chiropractic care access for all patients in our state. https://t.co/rQXWXfIoov
North Dakota’s nurses are some of the best in the nation. Thank you to Susan and Sherri with the @NDNURSES for sharing the work our nurses are doing to help their patients. https://t.co/rRfubbMNNN

Met with some North Dakotans who are in DC with @AmericanCancer. I am a sponsor of the Medicare Multi-Cancer Early Detection Screening Coverage Act, which will help ND Medicare beneficiaries access innovative early detection screening as soon as possible. https://t.co/iOHSx87BYG
Was thankful to catch up with North Dakotans representing @ACRheum today and hear how their providers are working to ensure high-quality care for patients. https://t.co/BOttFTiJ3Y
I appreciated visiting with @AAPAorg today. PAs play a critical role in meeting healthcare needs, particularly for rural communities in North Dakota. https://t.co/HkMu3i6pl9

We spend a lot of time talking about treatment. Treatment is the first step in recovery. We need more places like @HopeManorND in Bismarck that have incredible success rates in helping people make that next step. https://t.co/i91WM4WIh7

ND has many great rural healthcare providers like McKenzie County Healthcare System. I am a sponsor of bipartisan legislation including state opioid response authorization that will provide billions of dollars for communities across the country to fight the opioid epidemic. https://t.co/CiZyKancTb

The team at the Ridge Treatment and Reentry Center fills the incredibly important role of providing a supportive community for people facing addiction. We appreciate the great work they do in Fargo and across the Red River Valley. https://t.co/DWfU9Pf0aO
Kicked off the morning in West Fargo with a discussion on improving access to telehealth and mental health services for patients in rural communities. https://t.co/ASOteblLdq
As we prepare for 2023, the Farm Bill is a top priority. Appreciated talking with PIA of ND about the importance of crop insurance for North Dakota's growers. https://t.co/XwftHRiARk
Congratulations Jackie, David, and Darren. Local news coverage is important and we appreciate the work you do.

.@Heartviews in Bismarck and Cando provides treatment and education for substance use disorders.

We’ve made progress in making the scale of the opioid epidemic known, but we still have a lot of work to do to make sure patients can get the help they need. https://t.co/68QPSVR5ws

Nurse practitioners serve an important role in medical facilities across North Dakota and they are particularly essential in rural areas. Proud to support them as they work to ensure patients have access to timely and high-quality care. https://t.co/j99e16J7pN

I’m honored to team up and co-lead the bipartisan #SecondChance Task Force.

Providing tools and treatment to help incarcerated individuals re-enter society is important and reduces their chances of re-offending, making our communities safer.

Visited Dakota Pharmacy & Dakota PrecisionRx Labs in Bismarck this morning. The facility’s sterile compounding lab helps pharmacists provide personalized medication for patients across North Dakota and neighboring states. https://t.co/kvd5PHR20G

At @HouseCommerce, the CEO of TikTok tied himself in knots to avoid criticizing the CCP over its treatment of Uyghurs.

He deflected when asked about Chinese censorship.

TikTok’s relationship with the CCP exposes Americans’ data to exploitation by the Chinese government. https://t.co/UsJ0OpVSE4
Appreciated the update from the North Dakota Association of Farm Mutual Insurance Compaines at my Bismarck office today. https://t.co/VYlNi1s8EV

The team at Open Range Counseling Center in Dickinson provides mental health services to patients across the southwestern part of our state. It’s critical that North Dakotans can access the care they need no matter where they live. https://t.co/304MZ44hBc
